title: Understanding the Effect of Model Compression on Social Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the Bias Bench benchmark, which includes CrowS-Pairs (comparing probabilities of minimally distant stereotypical vs. anti-stereotypical sentence pairs), StereoSet (multiple-choice stereotype association tests for masked context sentences), and SEAT (measuring the cosine distance of sentence embeddings between gender attribute sets and target concept sets).
